description:
Non smoking, Modern, cozy stay in East Nashville— 10 mins to Broadway & Downtown. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street, our guest suite offers a peaceful rest near the city’s top spots. (Attached to the side of but completely separate from the main house) Enjoy quick access to local coffee shops, live music, vintage finds, and top eats. The perfect blend of Nashville energy and East Side charm.

The space
This newly built space combines comfort with style: think clean lines, natural light, and thoughtful amenities to make your stay easy and cozy. You’re steps away from beloved local spots like coffee shops, vintage stores, and foodie-approved eateries that give East Nashville its one-of-a-kind charm — minus the downtown noise.

What guests love:
• Quick drive to Broadway & Nissan Stadium
• Quiet, cozy street in a vibrant local area
• Brand-new space with modern amenities
• Great for couples, solo travelers, and work trips.

Whether you’re here to explore, work remotely, or simply recharge, you’ll find everything you need to feel right at home.

Book your stay and discover the best of both worlds — Nashville’s energy, and East Side’s soul.

Guest access
Guests have private access through the left-side gate, leading to a cozy pathway and your private entrance into the guest suite. (Attached to, but completely separate from the main house) Enjoy a full space with living room, dining area, kitchen (w/portable electric stove), king bed, AC, and outdoor bench seating. Backyard is for pet use only—our playful Goldendoodles love to jump! Driveway parking included. No laundry, but laundromat nearby. Smart Yale lock with custom code for each stay. **WHEN LEAVING**. To Lock the Airbnb while you’re out seeing the sights, please tap on the Yale symbol at the top of the lock, you should hear the deadbolt slide into place or the door is not locked.

Other things to note
PERSONAL SAFE:  Located in the kitchen cabinet to the left above the sink. The door should be open, there is a red button on the backside of the door, push it, it will beep twice. On the front keypad enter a 4-8 digit code followed by the E, it will again beep to let you know the code has been activated. When leaving, please take your belongings and leave the door slightly open.
